name: float_power_tensor_tensor_
description: Representative ATen schema: aten::float_power_.Tensor(Tensor(a!) self, Tensor exponent) -> Tensor(a!). The correctness suite also covers the Scalar overload. It computes float_power into self, returns the same Tensor object and storage, and leaves a Tensor exponent unchanged. Tests cover deterministic equal-shape and broadcast inputs, scalar exponents, zero-sized and noncontiguous tensors, special values, output metadata, mutation and identity, gradients, and rejection of non-broadcastable shapes.
